Checking would require computing the orbits of $\operatorname{Aut}(D_\infty)$ on the compatible maps $\lambda\colon D_\infty\to\operatorname{Aut}(D_\infty)$ explicitly, and confirming which invariants separate the resulting classes. Neither write-up does this in full.
